cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Lose Something for Me
cards.instruction: Create a loyalty test by asking them to accept a real disadvantage on your behalf.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Will you give me your first turn, even if it costs you the match?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. You said you were on my side. This side has a cost.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then lend the emotion a turn so I can see it.
